text:
Priya: AM triage check — queue at 42 (↑8 overnight). Main pain: billing uploads failing intermittently. Macros for 'payment failed' need refresh.
Sam: took overnight, saw repeated S3 503s. Opened INC-431 and assigned to infra. Workaround = instruct customers to retry; added retry steps to ticket.
Jordan: ticket breakdown: 42 open, 3 P1 (billing), 4 on hold waiting customer. PR #788 in progress to add upload retry + better logging. Need 1 reviewer.
Riley: updated the payment-retry macro draft, removed outdated support email and added KB link. Can someone sanity-check before I push live?
Sam: I applied temporary 'retry x3' macro change to console for affected customers. Will revert when fix lands. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: deploy to staging: deploy-2026-03-17-12 ✅ (build 1124).
Priya: @Jordan ping for review on #788 — CI shows linter failures this morning, likely trivial. Also @Sam can you confirm INC-431 severity?
Sam: INC-431 labeled severity-2, owner infra-oncall, ETA ~2h. I also consolidated 2 duplicate tickets from same org into one parent.
Jordan: pushed fix for linter, now only failing on a flake in uploader tests. Will rerun. Plan: merge after tests + deploy to staging, monitor uploads for 30m.
Riley: here's the macro snippet I changed — please copy/paste to verify formatting:
```
Title: Payment failed - Upload retry
Steps:
1) Ask customer to retry upload (up to 3x, 10s backoff)
2) If failure persists, collect `upload_id` and logs: /internal/logs?u={upload_id}
3) Escalate to infra via INC-431 and include requestor email + org id
Escalation: infra-oncall@redwood
KB: https://kb.redwood.internal/support/payment-uploads
```
Priya: looks good, please push live after @Jordan confirms deploy passes. Add note to macros about expected 503 transient window.
Jordan: staging tests passed, merging to main now. Will tag the deploy and notify this thread.
ops-bot: deploy to prod queued: deploy-2026-03-17-13 (waiting for approvals).
Sam: I left a note in the ticket for CS with canned response they can send while we monitor. Also flagged 5 related churn-risk customers.
Riley: quick ask — can someone with admin re-run the macro template tests in prod? I don't have admin perms.
Priya: re-ran macro test in prod, passed. Added escalation contact to the macro. Deployed the console change for the temporary retry message.
Jordan: merged PR #788 and triggered prod deploy. Monitor window starts at 13:05 for 1h. If uploads still fail, we'll flip to fallback route we tested yesterday.
Sam: will monitor alerts and consolidate any repeat errors into INC-431. I'll update this thread with major changes.
Priya: blockers? if infra doesn't respond in 30m, fallback goes live. Otherwise today's plan: monitor, finish CS messaging, update macros, and post post-mortem if needed.
Riley: I'll handle midday triage at 13:00 and pick up any fallout. Thanks team. :raised_hands:
